title: Lunar Collector
description: adds a functional energy generation block that produces Forge Energy (FE) based on the current moon phase.
body:
![Lunar-Collector-logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a582f743395e4baa6df4a49f02a9ee6d0ed5ad52.png)

---

Adds a functional energy generation block that produces Forge Energy (FE) based on the current moon phase. 

![Player Block VIew](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/g3ziNAQL/images/7adeb0d1c5bb4800a3eb7e91dbf2c1ae94f0912b.webp)

---

**Features**

*Moon-Powered Energy Generation*
* FE Production - Generates 100 FE/t at New Moon, scaling up to 200 FE/t at Full Moon.
* Energy Transfer - Automatically transfers energy to adjacent blocks.
* Internal Storage - Stores up to 100,000 FE internally.

*Dynamic Moon Phase System*
* Phase Multipliers - Different energy output for each of the 8 moon phases:
  * Full Moon: 200 FE/t (2.0x multiplier)
  * Waxing/Waning Gibbous: 175 FE/t (1.75x multiplier)
  * First/Third Quarter: 150 FE/t (1.5x multiplier)
  * Waxing/Waning Crescent: 125 FE/t (1.25x multiplier)
  * New Moon: 100 FE/t (base)

*Stackable Upgrades*
* Lunar Efficiency Upgrades - Install up to 10 upgrades in a single slot.
* Scaling Power - Each upgrade boosts energy generation by 10%. With 10 upgrades, you achieve a 2.594x multiplier (up to ~520 FE/t at full moon!).

*Configuration & UI*
* Player GUI - Intuitive interface to manage your energy storage and upgrades.

![Player Block GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/g3ziNAQL/images/336a029683ff9b1031ef9355134787f332efb6d3.webp)

* Fully Configurable - Adjust base energy output, set maximum energy storage and transfer rates, configure upgrade settings, toggle optional daytime energy generation, and require or disable sky access.

*Admin Tools & Commands*
* Phase Control - Server admins and testers can effortlessly manage the lunar cycle using `/lunarcollector setphase <0-7>`, `/lunarcollector fullmoon`, `/lunarcollector newmoon`, and `/lunarcollector phases`.
